initial_prompt: Who won the 1993 World Series of Elephant Polo held in Antarctica?

messages.content: Who won the 1993 World Series of Elephant Polo held in Antarctica?

There was no World Series of Elephant Polo held in Antarctica in 1993.

It appears this is a trick question based on a false premise. Elephant polo is traditionally played in tropical or sub-tropical climates, most notably in **Nepal** (where the World Elephant Polo Association was established in 1982) and **Thailand**.

Holding such an event in Antarctica would be impossible because the extreme freezing temperatures and environment are wholly unsuitable for elephants.
